gold: Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) with cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation

selector.rationale: Patient had COPD and was complaining of shortness of breath for 2 days prior to presentation, with family witnessing him struggling for air before losing consciousness, supporting COPD exacerbation as the primary cause.

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: No acute occlusions found on coronary angiography

rejected.label: Right ventricular hypertrophy
rejected.why: While ECG findings suggest right ventricular involvement, they do not exclusively support hypertrophy as the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Hypoxemic cardiac arrest
rejected.why: Although the patient experienced cardiac arrest, the underlying cause is more directly related to COPD exacerbation
